hero.headline: Where the mountains feel like family.
hero.subhead: Sixteen warm, light-filled cottages built for restful weekends, long summers, and slow Shabbosos in the White Mountains.

welcome.heading: A quiet corner of the White Mountains, kept for your family.
welcome.body: From the porch swing to the playground, White Cherry Cottages is built around the idea that a vacation should feel like exhaling. Our property sits on a wooded ridge in Bethlehem, NH — minutes from Franconia Notch, walking distance to shul, and an easy drive from Boston, New York, and Montreal. Whether you come for a weekend or the whole summer, our cottages welcome you the same way: warm wood floors, fresh linens, and a kitchen ready for your family.

teasers.title: The Cabins
teasers.body: Sixteen cottages, from one-room suites for couples to spacious 3.5-room family cabins.

teasers.title: Amenities
teasers.body: Heated outdoor pool, book room, playground, on-site shul and mikvah, and frozen food on hand.

teasers.title: The Gallery
teasers.body: A look around the grounds, the cottages, and the mountains that frame them.

quote.text: We came up for a weekend and ended up staying two weeks. The kids asked when we could come back before we'd even pulled out of the driveway.

closingCta.heading: Reserve your stay.
closingCta.body: Cabins fill quickly for summer and Yom Tov weekends. Call or email — we'll find the right cottage for your family.
